FaceDescriptorsData.description: Face Descriptors Data representing the facial features of an Entity. Each item optionally carries a Time, making the array an animation timeline: a sequence of face descriptors over time. The Time is format-independent - it applies whatever the content format of the descriptors (FACS Action Units, blendshape weights, landmarks) declared by the Qualifier. A single item without Time is a static (single-pose) face.

Time.description: Time of this face-descriptors frame within the animation. Format-independent; present when the Face Descriptors Data is a timeline.
